sharedDecisions: apps/app/src/app/globals.css must import @heroui/styles/css and define the semantic token layer before any screen can be judged. packages/ui writes text-muted (18 uses), bg-default (12), text-foreground (6) and bg-surface (5); none resolve today, which is the single cause of every screen rendering as raw HTML.

The token VALUES are an open product decision. Porting starci-academy-fe/src/app/globals.css wholesale would dress nivo in StarCi Academy's brand; the direction lab therefore uses a neutral placeholder palette.
The dashboard needs route-stable chrome (AppChrome) mounted as a sibling of the routed body at apps/app/src/app/layout.tsx. The sign-in route keeps centred-authentication-page and gets no chrome.
dashboard-main and dashboard-rail-then-main are NOT reusable for nivo: their why binds them to the academy's eight learner sections in a fixed reading order.
Sign-in keeps the approved case-a3 reading order: shortcuts first, divider, then the credential form kept mounted for password managers.
Every figure in the lab is a labelled fixture; only the field names are real.

preliminaryDirections.thesis: Same thesis as A - the fleet leads - but navigation moves from a top bar into the collapsible left sidebar StarCi already uses in /courses/[courseId]/learn.
preliminaryDirections.parityReference: starci-academy/src/components/blocks/navigation/CollapsibleSidebar (EXPANDED_WIDTH 16rem, COLLAPSED_WIDTH 4rem, collapse in place with no overlay, collapsed flag persisted in localStorage), SidebarNavItem (min-h-9, gap-2, rounded-large, px-3 py-2; collapsed mx-auto w-fit justify-center gap-0 px-2) and LearnSidebar (GROUP_ORDER clusters divided by a full-width rule, trailing badge in two tones).
tradeoffs: Eight destinations stay permanently visible and reachable in one press, and collapse to a 4rem glyph rail when the body needs the width

legacyDivergence: The reference is the course-learn sidebar, NOT the StarCi dashboard rail. The dashboard's 288px left column is a page-owned IdentityRail + QuickActions under a top ShellNav and is deliberately not what this direction copies.

contracts.why: Navigation stays a sibling of the routed body so a route change repaints the body without tearing the nav down.
Authentication is the route's only task, so its one bounded form sits at the visual centre.
The authentication form is one meaningful control group bounded by one card.
The label is held outside the surface it names.
Sections read as separate objects only while the space between them exceeds the space inside any of them.
Its why binds it to the academy's eight learner sections in a fixed reading order.
Same: it is the learner rail, not a nivo operations topology.
The fleet owns the flexible column while wallet and account facts stay a fixed rail.
A due obligation is one row of deadline, amount and the single action that clears it.
What is being built now sits above what could be built next.

The chrome sits beside the routed body rather than above it and survives the body being replaced; nav-over-body-page cannot express that, because its children are a navigation stacked over a page leaf.
A console body announces which section it is before its first section label, because the sidebar names the destination but not the state of it.
